object.name: evi_mattaverb
object.digest: True stereo one knob allpass diffuse reverb
object.description: A simple allpass diffusion reverb with minimal controls interaction. True stereo input/output, no early reflections, designed wet and spacey but very dampable. Unlike other evieve reverbs, this reverb has no external dependencies and can be operated in gen~ alone the same as in MSP.

attributes.name: damp
attributes.description: Flag 0/1, not smoothed. Selects onepole (0) or twopole (1) damping filters in the reverb chain. Greatly affects the tone of the reverb sound.

attributes.name: drywet
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attributes.name: high
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, high frequency damping EQ 0..1 less..more.

attributes.name: low
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, low frequency damping EQ 0..1 less..more.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, could be the only one knob control you need and much of the point of this reverb tuning. Small to large.

attributes.name: space
attributes.description: Flag 0/1, not smoothed. Add damping filters into the allpass feedback path (1) or not (0). Interesting wet sounds can be made by turning off filter stages here.
